your_book:
Jaleel's book closed Friday, August 28 modestly in the green overall, but the session had sharp cross-currents. The biggest drag came from the two highest-conviction tech names: NVDA shed -4.57% on semiconductor-sector weakness tied to pre-earnings nervousness and ongoing export-control overhang, while RKLB dropped -4.65% — deepening an already painful -17.8% unrealized loss on a position flagged AVOID. Together those two moves offset meaningful strength elsewhere. On the bright side, LULU surged +5.05%, ZTS added +3.09%, and SPGI gained +1.72%, with ABT and ADBE each contributing modest positive days. The software names (ADBE, SAP) caught a tailwind from a B of A price-target upgrade cycle, with analysts citing easing AI-disruption concerns — a direct counter to the narrative risk flagged on ADBE.

The thesis-versus-price divergence is most acute in two places. BSX carries an elevated risk flag (guidance slashed, flat through Q3) yet is rated STRONG BUY — the +0.36% day does nothing to close a -4.5% unrealized gap; the next read isn't until October 28. RKLB is the starker problem: AVOID-rated, -17.8% in the hole, and dropping again today with no offsetting catalyst in sight. LULU's pop is welcome but comes against a live guidance-cut flag and a September 3 earnings date that could reverse the move quickly.

Watch list into next week: NVDA earnings (if not already reported), the LULU September 3 print, and the pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) where drug-pricing policy pressure remains an unresolved overhang. GILD also slid -2.14% today on Ebola/WHO headlines — idiosyncratic noise, but worth monitoring given the MFN pricing backdrop already weighing on the name.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated, -17.8% unrealized, dropped another -4.65% today
attention.note: Price and thesis are fully diverged — the system rates this AVOID, losses are deepening with no catalyst identified, and continued holding requires an explicit rationale that doesn't currently exist in the data.

attention.headline: +5.05% pop with September 3 earnings 6 days away
attention.note: Today's bounce is happening directly in front of a print where Americas comps are -5% for the fifth straight quarter and tariffs have gutted margins — the rally could evaporate fast if guidance disappoints again.

attention.headline: -4.57% today on export-control and AI-capex sentiment pressure
attention.note: At 9.5% weight this is a top-three position, and the combination of China export-license tightening, Senate scrutiny, and sector-wide chip selling makes the risk flag active — not theoretical — heading into the next earnings catalyst.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed to 7–8.5% growth, still rated STRONG BUY, -4.5% unrealized
attention.note: The elevated risk flag (flat through Q3, Watchman/EP soft) and the unrealized loss are diverging from the bullish verdict — worth confirming the thesis holds before October 28 or adding further exposure.
